subject: Keep/reuse calculated objects in different plots

messages.author: 923fe81ce31443b2
messages.subject: Keep/reuse calculated objects in different plots
parts:
Hey Folks,

is it possible to reuse a calculated object in different plots?
Here is thing I am dealing with. After the user input, I perform a bigger calculation and plot the results. Afterwards the user can switch to a different tab an gets an alternative plot. But when switching to a new tab, everything gets recalculated, which again takes some time. Even if the input didn't change. So, is it possible, to keep the calculated object and only recall the plotting functions, depending on the tab? Of course, all under the premiss that the user input didn't change. Intuitively I would do it with the "<<-", but somethings telling me, that this is kinda dirty and insecure.

Best regards,

Mario
